home.title: Online Applications – Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei
home.subtitle: Online application system for Scholarships and Awards of the Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei.

layout.calls_subtitle: Calls for Scholarships and Awards of the Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei.

helpdesk.alert: We strongly recommend that you fill in and send the application online, avoiding the days immediately preceding the deadline, so as not to run into problems caused by a possible system overload.

push.subtitle: Install Online Applications Lincei on your device and receive notifications about new calls, deadlines, convocations and communications.

install.info: Add Online Applications Lincei to your device to open it as an app and receive notifications.

signin.concorsi: To take part in the online selections of the Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei you must sign in with the user name and password chosen during registration.

label.jconon_lincei_allegati_link: External link (instead of the file, for documents that are too large)

error.eta.max: The application cannot be confirmed: at the deadline the candidate would exceed the maximum age.
error.confirm.incomplete: An error has occurred while confirming the application. If the problem persists, please contact the Secretariat of the Academy.

information.detail: Personal information can be changed at any time, unless the account comes from SPID. Changes are not reflected in applications already sent or in draft: in that case please notify the Secretariat of the Academy promptly (segreteria@lincei.it)

call_manage.confirm_publish: Publish the call? The call will be visible to applicants.
